name: @futuremagic/sky
description: A physical sky for three.js WebGPURenderer games: Rayleigh/Mie sky with sun disc, phased moon, clouds, weather and horizon fog (TSL), stars, the sun/moon path and light as pure numbers, and the light rig the games share (SkyRig: physical albedos, sky fill through the environment map, eye adaptation, cloud shadows, grade over the day). From Scale and MasterWorld.
